summary.overview: The M&A catch-up meeting covered several key topics, beginning with a discussion on Halloween celebrations in the UK and US, led by Andy who shared insights from his recent Halloween party. The meeting then shifted focus to the Freshy handover, with Ramon working on a spreadsheet and a plan to follow up on leads in January to enhance the pipeline and closing rate.
